name: GitShow
description: GitShow turns any public GitHub profile into a developer portfolio and any public repository into an open source showroom. Replace github.com with gitshow.dev in any profile or repo URL - no signup, no config. Adds what GitHub does not show: npm download stats, smart repo categorization, tech stack visualization, focus areas, activity timelines, and open source contribution history.

skills.name: Developer portfolio
skills.description: GET https://gitshow.dev/{username} renders a portfolio for any public GitHub user.

skills.name: Repository showroom
skills.description: GET https://gitshow.dev/{owner}/{repo} renders a landing page for any public repo.

skills.name: README badge
skills.description: GET https://gitshow.dev/api/card/{username} returns a 460x56 PNG badge for README embeds.

skills.name: Social preview image
skills.description: GET https://gitshow.dev/api/og/{username} or /api/og/{owner}/{repo} returns a 1200x630 PNG.
